tasks.title: Establish the autonomous AI development loop
tasks.summary: Establish the repository-owned autonomous AI development loop: the .ai/ configuration, prompts, schemas and machine-readable state; the .openhands/skills/badminton-development skill; and the event-driven GitHub Actions workflows that implement the review -> fix -> merge -> next-task cycle. Infrastructure only - no product feature work.
acceptanceCriteria: `.ai/loop.config.json` declares maxReviewRounds, baseBranch, protectedPaths, requiredChecks, mergeGate, automation and label names, and validates against `.ai/schemas/loop-config.schema.json`.
The review stage is ChatGPT (`.ai/scripts/chatgpt-review.mjs`) and never an OpenHands conversation.
The merge gate merges automatically only when the review is approved, required CI is green, the head SHA matches the approval and no protected path changed.
A successful merge automatically generates exactly one next task and dispatches its implementation.
Exactly one implementation task may be active at a time (`maxConcurrentTasks` is 1).
The existing CI workflow is unchanged and still runs lint, typecheck, test, build and e2e.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass on the branch.
outOfScope: Merging any pull request by hand
